title: Correct tension expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be F_T = (m1*m2*g)/(m1+m2) or an equivalent algebraic form.

title: Correct mass ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the ratio m1:m2 = 1:2.

title: Newton's law for B
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to mass m2, resulting in m2*g - T = m2*a.

title: Newton's law for A
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to mass m1 on the table, resulting in T = m1*a.

title: System with added mass
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly set up equations for the modified system: m2*g - T2 = m2*a2 and T2 = (2*m1)*a2.

title: Relating the tensions
description: Important: The solution must use the given condition T2 = (3/2)*T to relate the two scenarios and solve for the mass ratio.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the acceleration signs are inconsistent between the two equations of motion (e.g., both objects assumed to accelerate in the same direction without a net force).

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Award credit for clear, logical algebraic steps leading from the system of equations to the final answers.
